cache_overlay.scope: Only byte-hashed Mathlib matches to the pinned cache are linked into a private directory. Compiler and third-party package objects retain their original import locations. Extra files are not placed on LEAN_PATH. No dependency was rebuilt.

dependency_scope: Reused Mathlib and third-party compiled dependencies; fresh objects for every selected packet module; no cold dependency rebuild or independent LeanChecker run.
